description: This is a shell script used for configuring, setting up, and building dependencies for a software project. It manages downloading, patching, and compiling libraries such as asprintf, libfyaml, libwebsockets, OpenSSL, and curl, as well as setting environment variables and paths based on the target architecture (linux or arm). The script facilitates environment preparation for the build process of the main project.

methods.name: dump_library_path
methods.description: A function to find the path of a specified library or header in given search paths and write the result to an output file.

methods.name: build_libwebsockets
methods.description: Configures and builds the libwebsockets library if not already built.

methods.name: build_openssl
methods.description: Configures and builds OpenSSL from source if not already installed.

methods.name: build_curl
methods.description: Configures and builds cURL library if not already installed.
